articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Images, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring tightly integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code, images, audio, and text in a single forward pass rather than routing through separate encoders. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement on complex multi-step software engineering tasks over GPT-5 base. The model also introduces a persistent working-memory mechanism that maintains context fidelity across sessions up to 500K tokens.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves Gold Medal Performance on International Math Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 solved 5 out of 6 problems on the 2026 International Mathematical Olympiad qualifying set, earning an equivalent gold-medal score. The system combines a chain-of-thought verifier with a formal proof assistant trained on Lean 4 corpora. This marks the first time an AI system has achieved gold-level performance on a full, contemporaneous IMO problem set without human-guided decomposition.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Unveils Atlas Gen-3 with Dexterous Manipulation and Tool Use in Unstructured Environments
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics demonstrated the third generation of its electric Atlas humanoid performing multi-step tool-use tasks in a simulated disaster site, including turning valves, cutting drywall, and carrying irregularly shaped objects across rubble. The new hands feature 22 degrees of freedom with tactile-sensing fingertips. The company says commercial pilot deployments for industrial inspection will begin in Q1 2027.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Robots Begin Limited Warehouse Operations at Third-Party Logistics Facilities
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that approximately 200 Optimus Gen-2 humanoid robots are now operating picking and packing tasks at two third-party logistics warehouses in Texas, marking the first commercial deployment outside Tesla's own factories. Early data shows the robots achieve roughly 70% of human throughput on standardized bin-picking tasks but operate continuously across three shifts. Tesla plans to scale to 1,000 deployed units by mid-2027.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Steering: A New Framework for Fine-Grained AI Behavior Control
articles.summary: Anthropic published a paper and released tooling for 'Constitutional Steering,' a method that allows deployers to specify nuanced behavioral policies as structured natural-language constitutions that are compiled into activation-space steering vectors at inference time. Unlike RLHF or prompt-based approaches, the technique reportedly enables precise control over model behavior dimensions—such as verbosity, hedging, and domain specificity—without retraining. Independent red-team evaluations show a significant reduction in policy-violation rates compared to system-prompt-only approaches.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of A14 2nm Node, Powering Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed volume production on its N2 process node using gate-all-around (GAA) nanosheet transistors at its Kaohsiung fab, with initial capacity allocated to AI accelerator chips from Nvidia and Apple. The node delivers approximately 25% higher transistor density and 15% performance gains at iso-power versus the N3E process. Industry analysts expect N2-based data center GPUs to ship in systems by Q2 2027, enabling significantly denser HBM4-equipped accelerator designs.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface with 4,096 Electrodes
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink clearance to begin a clinical trial for its N2 implant, which quadruples electrode count to 4,096 channels and incorporates on-chip spike sorting to reduce wireless bandwidth requirements. The trial will enroll 30 patients with cervical spinal cord injuries, targeting full cursor control and limited robotic arm manipulation. The approval follows 18 months of data from the first-generation PRIME trial showing stable signal quality beyond one year in the initial cohort.

articles.title: Figure AI and BMW Expand Humanoid Deployment to Full Assembly Line Integration at Spartanburg Plant
articles.summary: Figure AI announced an expansion of its partnership with BMW, deploying its Figure 02 humanoid robots across multiple stations on the X-series assembly line in Spartanburg, South Carolina. The robots now perform sub-assembly insertion, quality visual inspection, and inter-station parts transport using vision-language-action models fine-tuned on BMW's manufacturing data. This represents one of the largest integrated humanoid deployments in automotive manufacturing to date.
